name: hbar-cdp-stablecoin
description: HBAR-collateralised stablecoin: an HTS token minted by a CDP engine, priced by Chainlink and cross-checked by Supra, with liquidations, a Next.js vault UI and mirror-node activity.

steps.label: Start the vault UI against the reference testnet deployment

steps.text: Open http://localhost:3000, connect MetaMask on Hedera Testnet, deposit HBAR and mint the stablecoin.

steps.label: Run the contract test suite (HTS emulated locally)
Fund it with testnet HBAR (~30 HBAR covers deploy, token creation and the smoke test)
Deploy oracle + engine, create the HTS stablecoin, export ABIs
Produce verifiable testnet transactions (HashScan + mirror node links)

steps.text: README.md walks through every step; AGENTS.md briefs AI coding agents on units, HTS rules and invariants.
